description: Create a mono view from the B channel of an RGB view minus its scaled R channel. OIII = max(0, B - continuum_factor * R); any view of that name is replaced. Reports the new view's median and max.

continuum_factor.description: Multiplier on R subtracted from B

output_id.description: Name of the view to create; omitted = OIII_pseudo

name: extract_pseudo_oiii
